policy: Exactly ONE model method is active in this research line. Every other model method is archived with byte-identical source, its historical receipts remain resolvable at their original paths, and no archived method is reachable from the active runner.

generation_note: The three generations are different designs, not three settings of one design. A number from one generation is not comparable with a number from another: the architecture, the parameter count, the loss set, the readout and the input mask contract all differ. The first-generation A/B/C result is the only real patient measurement of any self-built architecture in this line, and it sits on the 5fold cohort that the original S0/R4/R3 baselines use.

archived_models.title: first-generation A/B/C ladder (8 slots, width 64, AdditiveInteractionReadout)
archived_models.lineage_note: This generation predates the role-target arms and is NOT one of their variants. It is a separate design: it has no role-content MSE, no role reference and no p/g residual roles. Its slot differentiation comes from the DeCUR representation terms and the across-patient variance floor instead.

arms.A: additive task-only baseline; no interaction, no auxiliary objective
arms.B: A plus the bilinear cross-modal interaction term
arms.C: B plus every auxiliary objective (shared common-head task 0.1, four DeCUR terms 0.05 each, across-patient variance floor 0.01)

losses: mean of the two modality-local common heads (C only, weight 0.1)
four DeCUR representation terms (C only, weight 0.05 each)

known_limits: one fold and one seed, so no difference carries an uncertainty estimate
the best-checkpoint number is a maximum over about thirty validation passes on the same 77 patients
the auxiliary objectives were measured at one weight setting only, with no per-term ablation

a budget confound remains in the C minus B step: A and B are single-view while C is two-view, so C costs 697 seconds against 479 and the difference contains both the auxiliary objectives and a doubled encoding budget
the update counts are unmatched, 1110 steps for C against 1140 for A and B

the variance floor was not satisfied: the across-patient standard deviations were 0.58, 0.29, 0.24 and 0.14 against a target of 1.0, and the cross-common alignment diagonal reached only 0.60 against a target of 1.0
